This month is marked by the Aani festival, during which devotees offer prayers to Lord Shiva and seek his blessings for prosperity and good health. The name Venki may also be associated with the popular Hindu god Venkateswara (also known as Balaji or Lord Vitthala), who is believed to bring prosperity and wealth.
